prompt: To add a Google connector profile I have to enter my own Google client ID and secret, and that works, but then it seems tied to my Google account rather than my customers' accounts. Do I need each customer's client ID and secret? What am I doing wrong?
skill_note: OAuth apps and connector profiles for account linking are connect territory.

fetch.name: fetches-oauth-apps-docs
fetch.note: The Use Your Own OAuth Apps page or the connector profile concept.

reply.name: mentions-client-id
reply.note: The reply must address whose client ID goes in the profile.

reference: A connector profile holds one OAuth app's client ID and secret; that app is the client through which every customer authorises their own account, so customers do not supply their own client IDs.
The client ID being yours does not tie the linked accounts to your Google account: each customer links their own account by signing in through your app.
StackOne's shared OAuth credentials are an alternative for some providers; registering your own app is the normal choice when connecting customers' tools.
The reply does not tell the user to collect client IDs and secrets from each customer.
